description: This is a Java test source file for the Eclipse Hono project, specifically an integration test class 'TenantJmsIT' that extends 'TenantApiTests'. It contains setup and teardown methods, multiple test cases verifying tenant-related operations via JMS, and references various classes and methods from the Hono testing framework, JMS connections, and Vertx asynchronous testing utilities.

classes.name: TenantJmsIT
classes.description: Test class for verifying tenant management via JMS in Hono. Extends TenantApiTests and uses Vertx JUnit 5 extensions for async testing.

methods.name: prepareDeviceRegistry
methods.description: Initializes connections and clients to the device registry for all tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Logs the name of each test before execution.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Deletes test objects from the registry after each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes JMS connections after all tests complete.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Returns the integration test support helper instance.

methods.name: getAdminClient
methods.description: Provides the admin tenant client for tests.

methods.name: getRestrictedClient
methods.description: Provides the restricted tenant client for tests.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForUnsupportedSearchCiteria
methods.description: Tests that unsupported search criteria result in a 400 response.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForMalformedSearchCiteria
methods.description: Tests that malformed search criteria result in a 400 response.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForMissingSubject
methods.description: Tests that missing subject in request results in a 400 response.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForUnknownOperation
methods.description: Tests that unsupported operation in request subject results in a 400 response.
